summary: Iteration 5: tested concierge chat, table map/VIP packages, join/approval/waitlist, guest list, and Host Studio from backend to UI (390px mobile web). Backend: 73/73 pytest pass (62 existing, with test_quantity_bounds updated, plus 9 new feature tests and 1 race test that passed on its run in the full suite). One extra race run showed an OVERSELL: 2 tickets were issued on a capacity-1 event when 8 joins ran at the same time (1 of 2 runs). Frontend: every requested flow works end to end. Two medium issues: timestamps are sent without a timezone and will show at the wrong time for users outside UTC, and one Host Studio cover image returns 404. No deprecated Expo packages detected; no SafeAreaView issues detected. All test data removed and users/Rooftop Reverie reset.

critical.issue: Two requests at once can oversell. join_event checks capacity with a no-op update ($inc tickets_sold: 0), then issue_ticket increments tickets_sold in a separate step. tests/test_nocturne_race.py: 8 joins at once on a capacity-1 event gave ['ticket','ticket',...] and tickets_sold=2 (1 of 2 runs). purchase_ticket has the same read-then-write gap. Fix: reserve the spots in one guarded update, update_one({id, tickets_sold: {$lte: cap-qty}}, {$inc: {tickets_sold: qty}}), then insert the ticket without incrementing again (undo the increment if the insert fails).

critical.endpoint: All datetime fields (events.date, created_at, last_at, event_date)
critical.issue: The Motor client is created without tz_aware=True (server.py:43), so the API returns naive ISO strings such as '2026-11-18T21:00:00' with no Z. The frontend calls new Date(str) (for example src/chat-view.tsx:94 and the event dates), which reads strings without an offset as local time. Outside UTC, event times and chat times are off by the UTC offset. Example: a Los Angeles host picks 9 PM, the app stores 05:00 UTC, and the event page shows 5 AM. Fix: AsyncIOMotorClient(MONGO_URL, tz_aware=True), or serialize datetimes with a UTC offset.

minor.issue: Approving 'approval' requests never checks capacity, so tickets_sold can go past capacity silently. Capacity only grows for waitlist approvals.
Nothing stops a member who already has a ticket from joining again. They can buy more tickets, or file a new approval request after being approved.

ui_bugs.issue: Cover #2 (COVERS[1] = photo-1571266028243-d220c9c3b31f) returns HTTP 404 from Unsplash, so the tile is blank. Reference: app/host/new-event.tsx:18

integration_issues.issue: Going back from /admin/thread/[id] shows the old preview text and unread badge until the next 5s poll. There is no query invalidation on send or on focus.

issues: Switch toggles use the default teal thumb on web (no thumbColor set), which clashes with the gold theme. Reference: app/host/new-event.tsx:203
Suggestion chips are 40px tall, under the 44px touch target. Their testIDs contain spaces (chat-suggestion-Book me a VI).

action_items: Make the join and purchase capacity check atomic: reserve tickets_sold in one guarded $inc before inserting the ticket (features.py:240-247, server.py:517-519, issue_ticket:556).
Return timezone-aware datetimes: AsyncIOMotorClient(MONGO_URL, tz_aware=True), or a pydantic serializer that adds the UTC offset. Then check the existing _aware() comparisons.
Replace the broken cover URL in app/host/new-event.tsx:18.

Optional: check capacity (or grow it) on approval-kind approvals; block repeat joins by members who already hold a ticket; invalidate the admin inbox query on reply; set Switch thumbColor; make suggestion chips at least 44px tall.
critical_code_review_comments: features.py join_event: the '$inc tickets_sold: 0' update is only a check and reserves nothing, so there is a race (confirmed by test).
decide_request: issue_ticket runs after the status change. If it fails, the request stays approved with no ticket (no compensation step).
event_guests and host_event_detail call find_one for each ticket's user (N+1). Fine at the current scale.
Table booking uniqueness uses a partial unique index, which is correct; the 409 was confirmed.

success_rate.backend: 100% of functional tests (73/73); concurrency defect found in separate race run
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows working; 1 broken image, 1 timezone display bug

seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST data created (tickets, table bookings, requests, concierge messages/threads, TEST events/venue) was deleted. tickets_sold restored, seeded users reset to bronze/wallet 0, Rooftop Reverie capacity is 2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. Container clock is around 2026-11-14. Seeded events have plus_one_limit 3. Venue owner and admin count as gold for tier rules. In Playwright, avoid force=True on table-* buttons: the sticky buy-ticket-btn can sit over the map and a forced click buys a ticket. Use locator.click() after scroll_into_view_if_needed. test_nocturne_race.py is flaky by design: it fails when the oversell happens. Run cleanup_iteration5.py after UI tests (adjust SINCE).
rca_of_issue: Oversell: join_event only checks capacity (no-op update), and issue_ticket increments separately, so two requests at the same time both pass the check. Timezone: Mongo stores UTC; Motor returns naive datetimes; pydantic writes them out without an offset; JS Date reads them as local time.
